en: When Land Becomes Cheap, What Will We Actually Own?
zh: 当土地不再稀缺，我们真正拥有的是什么？

excerpts.zh: 一个房间可以被重新配置的短视频，引出了对未来居住的想象。
excerpts.en: A video of a reconfigurable room prompted an imagined future of living spaces.

excerpts.zh: 如果空间不再是约束，改造空间的能力会不会更珍贵？
excerpts.en: If space stops being the constraint, does the ability to reshape it become more valuable?

excerpts.zh: 未来的家，也许可以把物理组件和视觉皮肤分开。
excerpts.en: A future home might separate physical components from its visual appearance.

excerpts.zh: AR 叠加在真实环境上，保留了身体与物理世界的联系。
excerpts.en: AR overlays the real environment while preserving contact with the physical world.

excerpts.zh: 如果家的组件是硬件，它们的排列方式是软件，会怎样？
excerpts.en: What if a home’s components were hardware and their arrangement were software?

excerpts.zh: 空间也许会拥有版本号，房间也许会拥有更新日志。
excerpts.en: Spaces might have version numbers; rooms might have changelogs.

excerpts.zh: 可重构的材料不等于可重构的生活，能源仍是现实约束。
excerpts.en: Reconfigurable materials do not guarantee reconfigurable living; energy remains a constraint.

excerpts.zh: 一个能适应你的空间，同时也是一个在观察你的空间。
excerpts.en: A space that adapts to you is also a space that observes you.

excerpts.zh: 在重新排列之前，空间应该先征得你的同意吗？
excerpts.en: Should a space ask permission before rearranging itself?

excerpts.zh: 当家没有固定形态，附着在某个角落的记忆要放在哪里？
excerpts.en: When a home has no fixed form, where do memories tied to a corner belong?

excerpts.zh: 交互设计也需要问：怎样让技术可以被人居住？
excerpts.en: Interaction design can also ask: how can technology become inhabitable?

excerpts.zh: 这篇随笔想象的是空间从财产变成媒介的可能性。
excerpts.en: This essay imagines space changing from property into a medium.
